name: OfficeKraft – Employee, Attendance & Leave Management
author: SiteAuditHub

sections.description:
OfficeKraft gives your team a separate, modern workspace at yoursite.com/officekraft/. Employees sign in on a branded login page and never need to open wp-admin.

Roles

  • Super Admin – full organization access: admins, workers, departments, settings, holidays and leave policies.
  • Admin – manages the workers who report to them: tasks, reviews, leave approvals and team attendance.
  • Worker – personal dashboard, assigned tasks, check in / check out, leave requests, calendar and personal productivity.

Every REST endpoint checks capabilities and team scope on the server. Admins only see their own team.

Features

  • Dashboards for each role, calculated from real records.
  • Employees: automatic employee ID, departments, designations, reporting admin, working schedule, activate / deactivate (history is never deleted).
  • Tasks: multiple assignees, priorities, categories, tags, estimates, attachments, comments with @mentions, subtasks, dependencies, recurring tasks, activity history, list / Kanban / calendar views.
  • Review workflow: Pending → In Progress → Under Review → Completed, with “request revision” (reason required) and reassignment. Overdue is calculated automatically.
  • Leaves: custom leave types, paid / unpaid, annual balances, half days, weekends and holidays excluded, overlap protection, cancellation requests, approvals by the reporting admin.
  • Attendance: check in / out, breaks, late and early detection with grace period, missing check-out alerts, correction requests, manager corrections with a reason, Team Today view, monthly calendar.
  • Office calendar (FullCalendar): tasks, deadlines, leaves, holidays, meetings and company events, with role-based visibility.
  • Projects with members, progress and activity.
  • In-app and email notifications with per-user preferences; reminders run in the background (Action Scheduler when available, otherwise WP-Cron).
  • WordPress privacy tools: personal data export and erase.

Privacy

OfficeKraft does not contact any external service, does not track usage and does not collect location or IP addresses. All libraries are bundled with the plugin.

The OfficeKraft admin screen has “Send a Suggestion” and “Leave an Honest Review” links, and after 14 days of use with at least 3 active employees, site administrators may see a dismissible review reminder (at most three times). The links open the SiteAuditHub feedback page and WordPress.org only when you click them; no data about you or your site is sent. The reminder’s dates and click totals stay in your own database and can be seen under Tools → Site Health → Info.

Source code and third-party libraries

Bundled libraries (all GPL-compatible):

  • FullCalendar 6.1 – MIT – https://github.com/fullcalendar/fullcalendar (unminified build included: assets/vendor/fullcalendar/index.global.js)
  • Chart.js 4 – MIT – https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js
  • Select2 4.1 – MIT – https://github.com/select2/select2 (unminified build included)
  • Lucide icons – ISC – https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide
  • Plus Jakarta Sans font – SIL Open Font License 1.1 – https://github.com/tokotype/PlusJakartaSans

All OfficeKraft JavaScript and CSS is shipped unminified.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. Go to Settings → Permalinks and choose “Post name” (recommended for clean URLs).
  3. Open OfficeKraft in wp-admin and click “Open OfficeKraft workspace”. Site administrators are Super Admins automatically.
  4. In the workspace, open Settings to set your timezone, office hours, working days, holidays and leave types.
  5. Add employees from the Employees page. New employees receive an email to set their password.

Share the login page link (/officekraft/login/) with your team, or add the [officekraft_link] shortcode to any page or menu.
sections.faq:
Does deactivating the plugin delete my data?

No. Data is only removed if a Super Admin enables “Delete ALL OfficeKraft data when the plugin is deleted” in Settings → Notifications & data, and then deletes the plugin.

Where are uploaded files stored?

In wp-content/uploads/officekraft-private/ with random file names. Direct access is blocked on Apache; on Nginx, add a rule to deny that folder. Files are always downloaded through a permission-checked endpoint.

Can I add more features?

Yes. Developers can use the officekraft_loaded, officekraft_rest_controllers, officekraft_pages, officekraft_allowed_mimes and officekraft_base_slug hooks.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Changed: the free plugin now focuses on employees, attendance, leaves, holidays, calendar, projects and tasks. Reports and CSV exports, employee documents, announcements and the audit log screen have been removed. Existing records stay in your database and are not deleted.

1.0.1

  • Improved: date and time fields (tasks and calendar events) use a date picker that closes as soon as you pick a day, plus a time dropdown.
  • Improved: the organization timezone is set automatically from the Super Admin’s computer on first use (only when it is still UTC). The timezone list shows the country and UTC offset, so you can search “India” or “+05:30”.
  • Improved: notifications arrive live without refreshing the page: a pop-up appears, the bell count and the browser tab title update, and you can turn on desktop alerts.
  • Improved: slim, modern scrollbars.
  • Improved: browsers load the newest scripts right after an update.

1.0.0

  • First release.
